about: The MW4 live check (desk control surface spec, Plan of Work, MW4): doperpowers desk-ctl-mw4, sminos 1.14.0, Claude Code 2.1.310, an isolated profile behind a recording stub (zero inference; the stub scripts the Agent call and keeps the subagent stepping with `sleep 2`). `capabilities` is the bridge's GET /status; `spawn` the background agent's spawn as the bridge's child keeps it in the tree (GET /agents); `stop` the bridge's answers to a stop by the Agent call's name, by an id, and of a foreground agent by name; `tell` its answer and the text the agent read at its next step; `unknown` the refusals of an agent no tree holds; `note` the row the parent read at its next request.

decide.interrupt.reason: a decision is answered once it is queued, so a deny cannot report what stopping the turn left running: deny, then Interrupt

media.reason: not in sminos 1.14.0: a later version of the plugin adds it

forget.reason: after --resume the engine brings back what a cut left out (2.1.310): it needs an engine fix or a supported cut

rewind-files.reason: the mod API has no file rollback: /rewind in the terminal

elicitation.answer.reason: a mod's answer carries no action or content, so it cannot answer an MCP server's form: answer it in the terminal
